name: Error-Derived Verification Rules
hypothesis: Explicit verification rules mined from historical failure modes reduce ambiguity errors without prompt exemplars.

arms.description: Generic fact-checking guidelines (Matched control without historical error mining)
rules_applied: Rule G1: Demand direct corroboration before marking Supported.
Rule G2: Check entity and number matches carefully.

arms.description: Rules derived from top historical error categories in Train Fold-1
rules_applied: Rule E1 (Temporal Mismatch): If an event year in evidence contradicts the claim year, mark Refuted, not Conflicting.
Rule E2 (Partial Support): If only 1 out of multiple factual sub-claims is backed by evidence, mark Conflicting Evidence/Cherrypicking, not Supported.
Rule E3 (Abstention Threshold): Do not default to Not Enough Evidence if any sentence directly negates the primary predicate.
